title: Fluctuations of the planar random walk sausage
summary: We establish fluctuation results for the volume of random walk sausage $R_n^{A}$ associated to a finite set $A\subset\mathbb{Z}^2$, where the underlying random walk $S$ has finite second moments. Precisely, we establish that the fluctuations are non-Gaussian and are described by the renormalized self intersection local time of planar Brownian motion, as in the cases of the range of random walks and the Wiener sausage.
